commands: # In the cloud, per batch NNNN (LOGS/ holds the batch's downloaded logs and is deleted after the batch):
# Locally, on the downloaded run folder RUN/ (pass outputs, manifests and battery extracts; no raw logs):
python -m log_validation.outputs merge -o noise-results.json --manifest RUN/manifest-noise.csv RUN/parts/noise-*.json
python -m log_validation.outputs merge -o response-results.json --manifest RUN/manifest-response.csv RUN/parts/response-*.json
for t in RUN/battery-obs/*.tar; do tar -xf "$t" -C battery-obs/; done
python -m log_validation.battery_fit --obs-dir battery-obs/ --manifest RUN/manifest-noise.csv --out-json battery-fit.json --out-md battery-fit.md

python -m log_validation.calibration_report --noise noise-results.json --battery battery-fit.json --response response-results.json --airframes airframes.json --run-info run-info.json --out-dir log_validation/calibration/2026-10-30 --forbid PRIVATE

parameters.batches: 9 batches of up to 20 GB; each batch folder holds the logs of both sets, so the noise and battery passes skip the response-only logs as logs without a manifest row
parameters.local_tool_commit: 58215506fb1686d83078501484f177e337c7a8a4, with the kit table committed alongside this directory; the cloud passes ran at tool_commit
parameters.noise_and_battery_set: logs logged at full or reduced rate and scenario logs of that screen
parameters.response_min_logged_rate_hz: 200 with 5 % tolerance, on the torque setpoint, rate and rate setpoint
parameters.response_set: the full-rate logs of that screen
parameters.selection: real (not simulated) quadrotor logs that passed a separate rate-loop data screen; duplicate uploads removed; at most 3 logs per vehicle (the smallest log IDs); vehicle IDs hashed
parameters.source: public PX4 Flight Review logs, read from a mirror; raw logs never left the cloud runner
